blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines and Canada have concluded negotiations for a free trade agreement (FTA) during President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney’s bilateral meeting on Saturday. The conclusion of negotiations was formalized through a joint statement signed by Trade Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque and Canada’s Minister of International Trade Maninder Sidhu. The accord is intended to be signed in 2027. This development came during Marcos and Carney’s bilateral meeting ahead of the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit and Related Summits, which will open on Sunday, Nov. 15.
